messages:
Ayla: Quick q — for the ISO evidence sampling on KMS/HSM entitlements, do we have an agreed sampling rate and owner? Need to confirm for fieldwork next week.
Jorge: I thought we agreed 5% for non-prod and 20% for prod keys? that's from the runbook draft but owner wasn't pinned.
Maya: we flagged that in the ticket but didn't assign. Ticket: #COM-842. :grimacing:
Ayla: yep — that's the one. @Ravi can you own coordination with infra and legal? we need an owner by EOD today.
Ravi: I can own coordination. I'll sync with Jorge and Sam. Plan to have an owner + sampling matrix by 1700 PT.
Sam: legal prefers sampling by entitlement group (admin, operator, svc-account). Can you include mapping to who signs attestations? also need retention window for the artifacts.
Jorge: noted. For prod HSM keys we have audit logs in GCS for 2yrs; non-prod 90d. Do we need to change retention? Ticket PR: https://git.redwood.ai/compliance/COM-842
Lina: auditor check — for ISO we need evidence that access was sampled across all entitlement groups and at least one external attestation. 20% seems reasonable for prod, but we need stratified sampling by region too.
Ayla: ok stratified by region + entitlement. Ravi will produce a matrix: columns [environment, region, entitlement_group, sample_pct, owner]
Ravi: putting a draft in the ticket in ~1h. quick question: do we run the sampling query from the auditlog service or do infra export CSVs?
Jorge: better to run from auditlog service to avoid transfer. I'll add an endpoint: /internal/compliance/samples?ticket=COM-842
ci-bot: deploy scheduled: compliance-service v1.14.2 -> staging at 1760000000 (automated)
Maya: one blocker — QA needs a sanitized dataset for reviewer access. Jorge can we add an anonymize flag?
Jorge: yes, adding param &anonymize=true. will test by 1500 PT.
Sam: owners — Ravi to confirm owner for each row; Sam to confirm legal sign-off; Ayla to confirm auditor evidence format.
Ravi: ack. I'll ping again when matrix is up. Also scheduling a 15-min sync tomorrow 09:30 PT — invite sent.
Ayla: thanks all. Action items: Ravi assign owners (EOD), Jorge add anonymize + endpoint (by 1500), Sam confirm retention & attestation format (EOD), Lina confirm stratification meets ISO (after matrix). :thumbsup:
Lina: noted, will review asap.
